subject: Agreement redlines: security exhibit sequencing and discrete evidence handoffs
messages:
From: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@medipath.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Security exhibit & evidence cadence for MSA + Order Form

Hi Vivek / Laura / Priyom,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was encouraged by the latency numbers. Procurement is progressing and legal asked me to surface a few items so we can lock an Order Form this month:

- We need a concise security exhibit for the MSA that captures SOC 2 commitments, a pen-test window, and explicit audit rights.
- Please confirm the evidence cadence (how often Redwood will share SOC 2 / bridge letters and ad-hoc evidence) and a standard pen-test notification window. Our security team prefers a 2-4 week notice for penetration tests and a published scope.
- If you have standard text you propose for limited inspection / scoped audits, send it over — our legal will redline.

Attaching our questionnaire (Medipath_Security_Questionnaire.pdf) — most items are clarifying with regard to data residency and audit sampling. We can be flexible on timing if Redwood can commit to a short, discrete evidence sprint and a clear mutual action plan.

Can you confirm next steps + proposed timeline?

Best,
Sarah Thompson
Head of Security Operations
MediPath Analytics

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@medipath.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security exhibit & evidence cadence for MSA + Order Form

Hi Sarah — appreciate the clear list. Quick proposal from our side so legal/procurement have something concrete to review:

1) Inspection window and pen-test notification
   - Standard pen-test notification: 14 days prior notice for full pen tests; ability to agree on shorter notice for targeted tests if mutually useful.
   - Limited inspection: Redwood accepts a scoped, timeboxed inspection (max 3 business days on-site/remote evidence review) with a pre-agreed list of documents and named evidentiary owners.

2) Evidence cadence
   - SOC 2: publish most recent SOC 2 report (year-end) and provide a bridge letter within 30 days of request for gaps under review.
   - Monthly operational summary: tokenized cost/latency breakdown is internal but we commit to an operational snapshot for security requests during onboarding and quarterly thereafter.

3) Redlines we expect from MediPath
   - Narrow audit scope to systems that process customer-controlled data (we propose Appendix A to enumerate those systems).
   - Keep pen-test communications routed through security@redwood.com and a single primary contact; limit requests for full production-side data exports.

I’ve put a first-pass redline in the attached (redline_draft_MSA.docx) and a short text file with suggested exhibit wording. Laura — could you review the draft and propose legal-safe phrasing for the inspection clause and the evidence cadence? Priyom — I can set up a 30-minute sync with MediPath security to walk through the questionnaire this week.

Proposed near-term timeline: evidence sprint kickoff Dec 7, deliverables by Dec 18, final Order Form signoff week of Dec 21. If that works for you we’ll lock the dates in the mutual action plan.

Thanks,
Vivek
VP, Partnerships & GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@medipath.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security exhibit & evidence cadence for MSA + Order Form

Vivek / Sarah — looping in a few quick legal points and a proposed carve that should be acceptable for both sides. Please see the proposed exhibit text attached (security-exhibit-proposed-text.txt). Key items inline below.

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 11:05 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> I’ve put a first-pass redline in the attached (redline_draft_MSA.docx) and a short text file with suggested exhibit wording. Laura — could you review the draft and propose legal-safe phrasing for the inspection clause and the evidence cadence?

Laura’s notes:
- Inspection/ Audit Rights: We can accept a scoped audit for systems that process Customer Controlled Data with a written scope and named owners. Limit inspection to technical evidence (configurations, logs, policies) and avoid unlimited access to engineering workspaces or source code. If MediPath requires deeper access, create a separate SOW for compliance-level inspections.
- Pen Test: Redwood will provide a 14-day notice for customer-initiated pen tests or agree to a mutually acceptable shorter window for in-scope tests. We want to require that the customer share a summary of findings and not publish exploit details.
- Evidence cadence: propose a default of annual SOC 2 (published), with ad-hoc evidence requests triaged through the security onboarding runbook. For critical customers we can commit to a quarterly evidence snapshot.

I’ll integrate the above into the redline and flag any language that could create an open-ended discovery obligation. Priyom — can you confirm operational owners and how we’ll package the evidence for a 3-business-day remote review?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@medipath.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security exhibit & evidence cadence for MSA + Order Form

Thanks Laura — that approach is reasonable and aligns with what our legal security team typically accepts. Two clarifying asks from our side: 

1) Bridge letter timing — can Redwood confirm you’ll provide a SOC 2 bridge letter within 10 business days of a written request? We often use that clause to get through procurement quickly and will rely on it during the initial 90-day onboarding.
2) Pen-test scope template — can you share a brief template that defines in-scope endpoints, allowed testing hours, and an escalation contact? That will speed our internal approval.

Attached is our SOC 2 summary (SOC2-report-2026-08.pdf) for reference. We’re comfortable with the proposed 3-business-day remote evidence review and the 14-day notification for full pen tests, pending the bridge letter timing confirmation. Once we have a redline with those two items, procurement will push the Order Form to signature.

Regards,
Sarah Thompson
Head of Security Operations
MediPath Analytics

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@medipath.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 16:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security exhibit & evidence cadence for MSA + Order Form

Sarah / Laura — great, thanks for the quick turn. Final mutual action plan below; please confirm and we’ll attach to the Order Form: 

Mutual action plan (summary)
- Dec 3: Redwood to publish final security exhibit redline (incorporates Laura’s carve + 10-business-day bridge letter commitment). Attachment: security-exhibit-proposed-text.txt
- Dec 7: Evidence sprint kickoff (remote); Redwood operational owners: Priyom Das (evidence consolidation) and Olga Petrov (technical access).
- Dec 7–11: 3-business-day remote evidence review window (targeted artifacts: SOC 2 report, config snapshots, access logs).
- Dec 14: Target delivery of redline MSA + signed Order Form (procurement dependent).
- Pen-test coordination: template and scope to be shared by Redwood security by Dec 4; standard notice 14 days.

Attachments to follow into the drive folder linked above; I’ve also attached a short mutual_action_plan.xlsx for procurement to import. If MediPath confirms the timeline today we’ll update the HubSpot deal (MP-2026-411) and queue the DocuSign packet.

Next step: Sarah, please confirm you accept the 10-business-day bridge letter and the Dec 7 evidence kickoff. If yes I’ll instruct contracts to create the Order Form with the security exhibit attached.

Thanks everyone — Vivek
VP, Partnerships & GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
